name: 34-caching-system-prompt-openrouter
description: cachingSystemPromptForOpenRouter (prompt-converters.js:1072-1113) with a 1h TTL. The first system turn (`find` at :1078, not a filter over every system turn) has **array** content whose *last* part is not text -- an image sits after the text part -- so the backward scan at :1098-1103 skips it and stamps the text part before it. The second system turn is left alone: only the first one is ever considered. The two non-system turns are untouched. Because the function returns nothing, the post-call arguments are the whole assertion.
